findings: Interpretation corrections and historical errata are recorded in report.md.
Fixed LF Markdown output and template normalization for deterministic Git checkouts.
Fixed temporary report builds omitting the extraction-diagnostics link by staging that evidence file; regression compares every experiment output.
No credentials found in changed text by credential-pattern scan; .env is untracked.

failure_history: Initial targeted tests failed while new reference modules and stricter measurement checks were being implemented; regression cases pass.
An early screened run had 98 passes and one stale-paper assertion; regeneration resolved it.
New HalfCheetah paper-generation tests initially lacked saved-result fixtures; fixtures now include the required evidence.
The LF newline regression first failed on Windows, then passed after explicit LF serialization.
A renderer attempt encountered OSError 22 writing an existing findings file; immediate unchanged-byte write and subsequent builds succeeded; cause not established.

The first complete deterministic check found five Markdown differences: temporary builds omitted vector_diagnostics.json and therefore omitted its link. Staging was corrected and the complete check rerun.
Poppler emitted unavailable display-font mapping warnings; all rendered pages were inspected and no missing glyphs were observed.
limitations: No policies, inference, gradients, training, simulator episodes or new video replays.
E1 fitted regression, power analyses, studentized sign-flip calculations and neural response-axis derivation remain unresolved as independent reproductions.
Frame-to-state movie correspondence is attributed to preserved receipts and saved-array equality, not independently established for every frame.
Historical screenshots and plots are preserved; corrected interpretations are in report.md.
Publication upload/deployment verification is recorded separately after the source PR is merged.
